2: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. Lord, do not rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
3: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
4: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
5: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
6: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.
7: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
8: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
9: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
10: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
11: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
12: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
13: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
14: But I, as a deaf man, do not hear. I am as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth.
15: Yes, I am as a man who doesn't hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
16: For in you, Lord, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.
17: For I said, "Do not let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."
18: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
19: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
20: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
21: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
22: Do not forsake me, Lord. My God, do not be far from me.
23: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
